description: Crawl one site's same-host pages starting from a URL (depth 1-2, at most 20 pages) and return each page's title, URL and readable text. When to use: you need several pages from one site (docs section, news index, product list) and web_map alone is not enough. Do not use: to mirror a whole site (hard cap 20 pages, same host), or for one page (web_fetch). Returns: {ok, url, final_url, count, pages:[{url, title, status, chars, content}], cached, took_ms, _metering}. Respects robots.txt and SSRF guards; partial page failures are skipped. Metered: shares the web free bucket (100 calls/day per IP shared by all ten web tools), then 3 credits per call over x402 - no API key.
name: web_crawl
title: Web Crawl
